consigna: Friday, spoken: talk for 90 seconds about a problem you had and how you solved it — at home, at work or on a trip. You may write two or three ideas first, but do not read a text.
requisitos: Ask for help in two different ways (week 26)
microtareas: *Mon (10 min).* Read your corrections from weeks 26 to 33. Which mistake keeps coming back? Write it down.
*Wed (5 min).* Write three sentences without that mistake.
*Fri (5 min).* Record 90 seconds and listen to it once.
autochequeo: Did I ask for help clearly?
promptCorreccion: This is a review of three things at A2 level: asking for help, opinion with a reason, and the past simple. (1) For each one, say if it is there and if it is correct. (2) Tell me my most frequent mistake. (3) Give me one sentence with all three. Correct nothing else. ---
